highlights: A new project can start Project Chat again: an interrupted first qualification no longer leaves the project permanently unable to connect.
Stop genuinely cancels an Agent Chat run instead of clearing the composer while the agent keeps working.
Legacy projects move into Project Chat through a verified copy that leaves the original project, its shares, apps, and deployment untouched.
Backups run again when the PostgreSQL server sits a patch behind the client security floor, which previously blocked every backup outright.
Native provider sign-in no longer fails its own attestation, a failed xAI attempt no longer locks the provider, and setup errors name the cause.
